description: Per-repository source, license, pin, Rust target, parity contract, and enhancement record for Elementary projects directly used by M-series image customizations.

update_policy.pin_change_gate: Review the project diff, confirm its license at the pinned revision, run the project's parity/build gate, and record image/hardware qualification before changing the active pin.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

pin.meaning: OS 9 source-audit comparison point, not a claim that this is the current upstream head.

projects.rust_target: A Rust project for every executable image-build, installer, and update component, with generated declarative mkosi inputs where the upstream interface requires them; full build-contract parity is required.
intentional_enhancements: M-series Apple Silicon image and sysupdate profile, tracked separately from elementary's baseline behavior.
projects.qualification: The source audit baseline is pinned; the full Rust build-system replacement and image parity are not complete.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust compositor/window-manager project preserving Gala's compositor, plugin, and desktop-session contracts.
projects.qualification: Native patches and their source pin are tracked; no Rust compositor or desktop parity claim exists.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust panel host and indicator-extension system that preserves the current Wingpanel protocols and desktop integration.
projects.qualification: The Rust host and extension ABI are not implemented or qualified.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

pin.note: The installer fetches the tag; record and verify its resolved commit before advancing it.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust dock/window-switcher project preserving the Pantheon launcher and dock contracts.
projects.qualification: The upstream tag and local patch are tracked; Rust behavior and parity remain unimplemented.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust file manager project preserving Files' file, portal, mount, and desktop integration contracts.
projects.qualification: The native portal fix is tracked; Rust application parity remains unimplemented.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A Rust Quick Settings host and extension API that preserves system controls and allows independent Rust widgets.
intentional_enhancements: M-series charge-limit, display-brightness, and keyboard-brightness widgets
projects.qualification: The local widget patch is tracked; no Rust host/widget parity claim exists.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A Rust panel network indicator plus separate Rust usage service preserving NetworkManager, Wingpanel, SQLite, and DNS-event contracts.
projects.qualification: The Rust usage daemon has fixture coverage; indicator replacement and live desktop parity remain open.

license.evidence: GitHub repository license declaration; retain and verify the license file at the selected source revision.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust panel-power indicator preserving UPower state, settings, and Wingpanel plugin behavior.
projects.qualification: The upstream pin and local patches are recorded; Rust indicator parity remains unimplemented.

license.evidence: Installed package copyright metadata and retained upstream license file.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust sound indicator preserving PulseAudio/PipeWire, player-control, and Wingpanel behavior.
projects.qualification: The source and plugin digest are pinned; the initialization patch is a bug fix, not a parity exemption.

license.evidence: Installed package copyright metadata and retained upstream license file.

projects.rust_target: A separate Rust keyboard-layout indicator preserving layout selection, Wingpanel, and accessibility behavior.
projects.qualification: The source and plugin digest are pinned; the selected-state initialization patch is a bug fix, not an enhancement.
